create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal structure with a specified number of atoms using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal lattice with a specified number of unit cells using get_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells
create_water_box: create a random box of water molecules with configurable count and box size using get_water_box
create_slab_adsorbate: create an FCC slab with an adsorbate molecule and OC20-style atom tags using get_slab_adsorbate
create_slab_with_custom_adsorbate: create a Cu(111) slab with a custom adsorbate molecule like CO or H2O using get_slab_adsorbate
